classification.difficultyReason: Form arc-length and sector-area equations in two unknowns, eliminate the angle by division or substitution, and recover exact values; part (a) explicitly cues simultaneous equations before the parallel second task.

children.label: a
children.prompt: The sector $OAB$ below has an area of $\frac{\pi}{2}\text{ cm}^2$. The arc has length $\frac{\pi}{4}$ cm. By solving a pair of equations simultaneously, find the exact values of $r$ and $\theta$.

spec.description: Unshaded sector opening right, with O at the vertex, A above B, two radius labels and matching single ticks. The central angle is labelled θ.
spec.mathematics: OA = OB = r; the central angle is θ. The schematic angle is not a numerical given.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown r and θ only; no answers displayed.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}r\theta&=\frac{\pi}{4}\qquad(1)\\\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta&=\frac{\pi}{2}\qquad(2)\end{align*}$$
Divide equation (2) by equation (1):
$$\begin{align*}\frac{r}{2}&=\frac{\frac{\pi}{2}}{\frac{\pi}{4}}\\\frac{r}{2}&=2\\r&=4\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
Substitute into equation (1):
$$\begin{align*}4\theta&=\frac{\pi}{4}\\\theta&=\frac{\pi}{16}\text{ radians}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: The area of a sector is $\frac{3\pi}{10}\text{ cm}^2$ and the arc length cut off by the sector is $\frac{\pi}{5}$ cm. Find the exact value of $r$ and $\theta$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}r\theta&=\frac{\pi}{5}\qquad(1)\\\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta&=\frac{3\pi}{10}\qquad(2)\end{align*}$$
Divide equation (2) by equation (1):
$$\begin{align*}\frac{r}{2}&=\frac{\frac{3\pi}{10}}{\frac{\pi}{5}}\\\frac{r}{2}&=\frac{3}{2}\\r&=3\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
Substitute into equation (1):
$$\begin{align*}3\theta&=\frac{\pi}{5}\\\theta&=\frac{\pi}{15}\text{ radians}.\end{align*}$$
